notes.title: 1.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Features Added[/b]
- Prepare for new cards and event
- Tutorial Flow Update
- Shop Content Update
- New Card Stories
- Minor UI Update
- Minor bug fix.

[b]Balancing[/b]

- Blocker
From
■  Player cannot attack other characters while there are enemy [b]blocker[/b] on the battlefield. Each [b]Blocker [/b]could block once each turn.
To
■ Player cannot attack other characters while there are enemy [b]blocker [X][/b] on the battlefield. Each [b]Blocker [/b]could block once each turn.

- Laevatain's Flame Ball
From
■ Summon a ""Relic"" onto the battlefield, with the effect, ""After this takes damage, shoots two flame balls that randomly split among all enemy targets that deal 2 damage each.""
To
■ Summon a ""Relic"" onto the field, with the effect, ""After you play a card, deal 2 damage that randomly split among all enemy targets."""

- Shun, Soul Reaper
From
■ Summon-Trigger: If you have 10 or more cards in your graveyard, choose a Follower. It gets -7 Attack until the end of their turn.
■ After this Follower attacks, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.
To
■ Discarded, or after this Follower attacks, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.
■ S-T: If you have 10 or more cards in your graveyard, choose a Follower. It gets -7 Attack.

- The Egg of Emancipation
From
■ Death-Trigger: Draw a Release Follower from your deck. Reduce the cost of a Release Follower in your hand by 1.
To
■ Discarded or Death-Trigger: If you are holding a Release Follower, reduce the cost of a Release Follower in your hand by 1."

-  Gate of Eden
From
■ Summon a ""Relic"" onto the field, with the effect, ""At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to this Follower, then summon the highest cost Follower from your mana zone onto your battlefield.""
To
■ Summon a ""Relic"" onto the field, with the effect, ""At the end of your turn, summon a Follower that cost 5 or less in your mana zone."""

- Gate Deities of the Underworld
From
■ At the end of your turn, reduce the cost of a random Mecha in your hand by 2. Return a Mecha into your hand from your graveyard.
To
■ After a friendly Follower is destroyed, return a Mecha to your hand from your graveyard.

notes.title: Steam Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[h2]"Realm of Alters" Steam Early Access Launch![/h2] 
It is playable cross-platform! Players can play against any opponent regardless of the device or platform used by each. Players will also be able transfer their accounts between both platforms too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670127/819e652e5f768c32306dfdfa86a177f50b17c15e.png[/img]

[h2]New Rank Season [/h2]
It is starting on the same day of Steam EA launch, and will bring richer achievements, levels and season rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670127/95e27b5d96cd7fe45087f11723e59f1fe9578792.png[/img]

[h2]3rd Card Expansion (Coming in Mid October)
30 New Cards, New Keywords.[/h2]
In this version update, we have made balance on multiple cards, including cards with [Insight] mechanism. We are also implemented more abilities, such as the [Stealth] and [Burn]. Followers with [Stealth] can avoid enemy targeting and make more complex deployment on the battlefield. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670127/c377ca613ca841985767813b06edbab4ebea8d2a.png[/img]

[h2]New Shop Pricing[/h2]
[Designated Rarity Card] is now set as a permanent purchasable item. We have also increased the amount of items that can be purchased with in game currency, GOLD Coins (obtained by winning Battles), and increased the product discounts in the Daily Special Section!

[h2]More Localizations[/h2]
In order to promote "Realm of Alters" to more players in different regions, we have localized Indonesian (Available Now) and Spanish (Coming Soon)!
